::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 25th [1872-1891]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin
:::

My dear [Mrs Beck](people/person_130.qmd)
Thank you much for your kind invitation. I am sorry to say that Saturday is a day I never can go out as I have Church decoration always more or less on my hands that day. – Poor [Gertrude](people/person_1462.qmd) has rather a bad time just now,  her leg has been very painful

Yours very sincerely
C M Yonge
